# serverguard24_check_contact_link (Resource)

Links a monitoring check to a contact.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "serverguard24_check_contact_link" "http_ops" {
  check_id   = serverguard24_check.http.id
  contact_id = serverguard24_contact.ops.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `check_id` (String) ID of the monitoring check.
- `contact_id` (String) ID of the linked resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the form `check_id/second_id`.
